label: Urgency Text
purpose: Display time-sensitive messages to create urgency and drive conversions

custom_text.default: 🔥 12 people are viewing this right now!

_notes:
Creates FOMO and urgency. Shows messages like '12 people viewing', 'Only 3 left', '5 sold in last hour'. Can use dynamic counters or custom text. Richtext MUST be wrapped in

tags.
